description: Shrinking coverage ledger for Layer 2 adversarial config mutations across the six coupled physics anchors (gh#2098, part of gh#2083 and gh#1991). Covers both scalar leaves and scalar elements inside wrapped/plain arrays. Every non-conforming outcome (dropped/truncated from engine YAML, null/empty in engine YAML, silent site-scalar default on omit, unattributed rejection such as raw TypeError drift wrappers, invalid type/non-finite emission, or unexpected default value) must match an explicit issue-linked entry; stale entries fail the test so the ledger strictly shrinks as follow-up fixes land.

categories.active_gap: Active parameter on the listed anchor(s) that is silently dropped, nulled, or given a hardcoded site default instead of being rejected or emitting a valid documented default.
categories.inactive_optional: Optional parameter whose governing physics branch is disabled on the listed anchor(s), paired with active-anchor coverage where the branch is enabled.
categories.optional_control: Optional run-control metadata resolved at execution time when omitted.
categories.unwired_parameter: Parameter not currently wired across the bridge/kernel (tracked separately).

entries.active_condition: Always active for every site; validate_site_required_fields lists all 11 scalars as required.
entries.rationale: SiteProperties fills hardcoded site defaults (e.g. lng=-0.13, lat=51.5, z=10.0) on omit instead of rejecting; omitting them from engine YAML silently substitutes 0.0 in the Rust bridge for 9 of 11 scalars and triggers kernel error 14/110 for z and z0m_in.

entries.active_condition: Optional overrides; unset start_time/end_time span the full forcing period and unset output.freq defaults to 3600 s at save time.
entries.rationale: Runtime-derived run-control overrides remain Optional[None] by design.

entries.active_condition: Optional in YAML when meteorological forcing is supplied programmatically through SUEWSSimulation.update_forcing().
entries.rationale: ForcingControl.file allows null when forcing is passed in memory; null forms are dropped from engine YAML.

entries.active_condition: Inactive on the open-water surface, which has no subsurface soil store.
entries.rationale: Water inherits BaseSurfaceProperties soil fields that are physically inactive for open water.

entries.active_condition: Active for all six non-water surfaces with sfr > 0; omitting store_max silently alters runoff and QE.
entries.rationale: StorageDrainParams.store_max defaults to None and is silently dropped on omit or nulled in engine YAML (drain_coef_1 and drain_coef_2 are enforced in schema 2026.6.dev15).

entries.active_condition: Open water does not use surface-drainage equations (sample_config ships -999 sentinels for water drainage).
entries.rationale: Water drainage coefficients are inactive; tracked alongside non-water drainage contract cleanup.

entries.active_condition: Active when storage_heat uses OHM (1) or DyOHM (6).
entries.rationale: OHM coefficients a1/a2/a3 default to None and are dropped or nulled in engine YAML even under active OHM storage heat.

entries.active_condition: Inactive when storage_heat=5 (EHC) handles all facets.
entries.rationale: OHM coefficients are unused under explicit heat conduction (storage_heat=5).

entries.active_condition: OHM thresholds are active under OHM/DyOHM (storage_heat=1,6); AnOHM parameters are active under storage_heat=3.
entries.rationale: Fields carry non-None defaults (so omit emits non-null) but Optional[...] annotations allow explicit bare/wrapped null into engine YAML.

entries.active_condition: Active for vegetated surfaces (evetr, dectr, grass) with sfr > 0 under modelled LAI (laimethod=1).
entries.rationale: LAI power exponents default to None and are silently dropped on omit, freezing seasonal LAI growth.

entries.active_condition: Inactive when leaf_area_index=observed (laimethod=0); base_temperature_senescence and sdd_full are rejected on the 5 modelled-LAI anchors.
entries.rationale: Phenology GDD/SDD thresholds and LAI power exponents are not required when LAI is prescribed from forcing.

entries.active_condition: Inactive when leaf_area_index=observed (laimethod=0); rejected on all 3 mutations on the 5 modelled-LAI anchors (wrapped_null already rejected on all 6).
entries.rationale: GDD growth thresholds are inactive when LAI is observed from forcing.

entries.active_condition: Active under emissions=12 (CO2 emissions enabled); emission_co2_point_source is already rejected on all 3 mutations.
entries.rationale: Remaining nine CO2Params scalars default to None and are dropped or nulled even when CO2 emissions are active.

entries.active_condition: Inactive when emissions=2 (non-CO2 heat method); emission_co2_point_source is rejected on co2_methods.
entries.rationale: Anthropogenic CO2 parameters are optional when CO2 emissions are disabled.

entries.active_condition: Active for vegetated surfaces (evetr, dectr, grass) with sfr > 0 under emissions=12; omitting theta_bio_co2 or beta_bio_co2 produces NaN FcPhoto/Fc.
entries.rationale: Biogenic CO2 scalars default to None and are silently dropped or nulled under active emissions=12.

entries.active_condition: Active for vegetated surfaces under biogenic CO2 methods; omit emits defaults while Optional[...] allows explicit null.
entries.rationale: Enhanced biogenic CO2 coefficients accept bare/wrapped null under active emissions=12 despite min_res_bioco2 rejecting null.

entries.active_condition: Inactive when emissions=2 (biogenic CO2 disabled).
entries.rationale: Biogenic CO2 scalars are unused when emissions does not enable biogenic CO2.

entries.active_condition: Inactive when emissions=2; min_res_bioco2 already rejects explicit nulls on co2_methods.
entries.rationale: Biogenic CO2 defaulted parameters remain nullable when biogenic CO2 is disabled.

entries.active_condition: Active when snow_use=1 (snow_cold anchor).
entries.rationale: Snow density bounds and rain/snow threshold default to None and are silently dropped or nulled even when snow_use=1.

entries.active_condition: Inactive when snow_use=0 (snow disabled).
entries.rationale: Snow density bounds and precipitation threshold are unused when snow is disabled.

entries.active_condition: Active when snow_use=1 (snow_cold anchor); omit emits defaults while Optional[...] allows explicit null.
entries.rationale: Snowpack limits and initial snow states accept explicit null/wrapped-null even when snow_use=1.

entries.active_condition: Inactive when snow_use=0 (snow disabled).
entries.rationale: Snowpack limits and snow initial states are inactive when snow processes are disabled.

entries.active_condition: Active when snow_use=1 with OHM-calling storage heat (snow_cold anchor; wired in #2109, winter_wet read by OHM).
entries.rationale: Active snow winter_wet OHM coefficients a1/a2/a3 default to None in OHMCoefficients and are dropped or nulled in engine YAML even when snow OHM is active.

entries.active_condition: Inactive when snow_use=0 (snow disabled).
entries.rationale: Snow winter_wet OHM coefficients are unused when snow processes are disabled and permit conditional absence under BR-03.

entries.active_condition: Unconsumed across all anchors: OHM (suews_phys_ohm.f95) evaluates snow deltaQi unconditionally from winter_wet OHM_coef(nsurf + 1, 3, 1:3).
entries.rationale: Non-winter_wet snow OHM regimes are transported when present but never read by OHM, so conditional absence is permitted under BR-03.

entries.active_condition: Unconsumed across all anchors: OHM (suews_phys_ohm.f95) does not switch snow regimes via OHM_threshSW(8) or OHM_threshWD(8).
entries.rationale: Snow OHM thresholds are transported when present but never read by OHM, so conditional absence is permitted under BR-03.

entries.active_condition: Active when stebbs.enabled=True (spartacus_ehc_stebbs anchor); wall/window/ground STEBBS fields already reject explicit nulls.
entries.rationale: STEBBS roof and outer-layer archetype fields escape _validate_stebbs required-field null checks even when STEBBS is enabled.

entries.active_condition: Inactive when stebbs.enabled=False; active STEBBS wall/window/ground fields reject explicit nulls on spartacus_ehc_stebbs.
entries.rationale: STEBBS and building_archetype RefValue fields remain nullable when STEBBS is disabled.

entries.active_condition: Inactive when stebbs.enabled=False; rejected on spartacus_ehc_stebbs (wrapped_null already rejected on all 6).
entries.rationale: archetype_name is a plain Optional[str] when STEBBS is disabled.

entries.active_condition: Inactive when stebbs.internal_shading == 0 (shading disabled on all six anchors; required when internal_shading is 1 or 2).
entries.rationale: Conditional STEBBS shading thresholds stay nullable while internal_shading is 0.

entries.active_condition: Active under SPARTACUS/EHC facet moisture/conduction (net_radiation=1003, storage_heat=5).
entries.rationale: Vertical-layer facet soil_store_capacity defaults to None and is dropped or nulled under active SPARTACUS+EHC.

entries.active_condition: Inactive when SPARTACUS radiation and EHC facet conduction are disabled.
entries.rationale: Vertical-layer facet soil_store_capacity is unused outside SPARTACUS/EHC.

entries.active_condition: Active when EHC (storage_heat=5) or DyOHM (storage_heat=6) evolves surface/inner temperatures.
entries.rationale: Initial surface and inner temperatures carry defaults on omit but Optional[...] allows explicit bare/wrapped null into engine YAML.

entries.active_condition: Inactive under OHM-only storage heat (storage_heat=1).
entries.rationale: Surface/facet initial conduction temperatures are unused under OHM storage heat.

entries.active_condition: Active whenever at least one right-closed local-standard delivery date in the run satisfies water_use=modelled (WaterUseMethod==0), Fortran DayWat(wd)==1.0 (wd from Day_Of_Week: 1=Sun..7=Sat indexed into [sunday..saturday]), AND Fortran inclusive hemispheric season (lat>=0: ie_start <= doy <= ie_end; lat<0: ie_start <= doy <= ie_end when ie_start <= ie_end, else doy >= ie_start or doy <= ie_end), independent of faut or irrigation_fraction: update_WaterUse (suews_phys_dailystate.f95) adds ponding demand WUDay_P unconditionally to WUDay_A/WUDay_total.
entries.rationale: IrrigationParams.h_maintain defaults to None and is dropped by exclude_none=True instead of being rejected or emitting an explicit value; omitting it from engine YAML silently substitutes 0.0 (enabling ponding up to SoilStoreCap) in IrrigationPrm::default() rather than disabling ponding (-999.0).

entries.active_condition: Inactive ONLY when zero actual simulation dates satisfy WaterUseMethod==0 AND DayWat(wd)==1.0 AND the Fortran hemispheric season predicate (e.g. water_use=observed on observed_and_dyohm, all daywat.*==0.0 on the four non-irrigation modelled anchors, closed season such as NH 280..100, or closed weekdays outside the simulation window). Neither faut==0 nor irrigation_fraction==0 disables h_maintain.
entries.rationale: h_maintain is unread when WaterUseMethod==1 or all DayWat(1:7)==0.0; under WaterUseMethod==0 with DayWat(wd)==1.0 it remains active even when faut==0 or irrigation_fraction==0.

entries.active_condition: Active when water_use=modelled (WaterUseMethod==0) with irrigation.daywat.* == 1.0 (internalwateruse_h splits total water use when wu > 0 at suews_phys_waterdist.f95:1420-1437; ie_start/ie_end pairing enforced on active modelled irrigation via SUEWSConfig and Phase B).
entries.rationale: IrrigationParams.internalwateruse_h defaults to None and is silently dropped or nulled under active modelled irrigation.

entries.active_condition: Inactive when water_use=observed (WaterUseMethod==1 with zero observed water use, observed_and_dyohm) or when water_use=modelled with all irrigation.daywat.* == 0.0 (the four non-irrigation modelled anchors), so update_WaterUse does not evaluate ie_start/ie_end and total water use wu == 0.
entries.rationale: ie_start and ie_end are skipped when WaterUseMethod==1 or all DayWat(1:7)==0.0 (passing neutral 0/0 to Fortran); internalwateruse_h has no external/internal redistribution effect when wu == 0 and defaults to 0.0 in these anchors.

entries.active_condition: Active under modelled irrigation (irrigation_and_dls anchor); omit emits 0.0 while Optional[...] allows explicit null.
entries.rationale: Per-surface irrigation_fraction accepts explicit bare/wrapped null under active modelled irrigation.

entries.active_condition: Inactive when water_use=observed (WaterUseMethod==1, observed_and_dyohm) or when all seven irrigation.daywat.* flags are 0.0 (so update_WaterUse outputs WUDay_id==0 on the four non-irrigation modelled anchors).
entries.rationale: Per-surface irrigation_fraction is unused when modelled irrigation is inactive.

entries.active_condition: Active for DayProfile and WeeklyProfile scalar fields (omit emits defaults and wrapped_null rejects, while bare_null drops the key).
entries.rationale: DayProfile and WeeklyProfile fields are plain Optional[float] with defaults, so bare null is accepted and dropped by exclude_none=True.

entries.active_condition: Active for 24-hour diurnal profiles; setting an hour slot to null passes validation and emits null into engine YAML.
entries.rationale: HourlyProfile working_day/holiday mappings allow dict values of None and serialize them as null in engine YAML.

entries.active_condition: Active when stebbs.enabled=True (spartacus_ehc_stebbs anchor); omitting or nulling a 10-minute slot passes validation.
entries.rationale: 144-step STEBBS profile dicts do not require complete slot coverage on omit and accept null slot entries.

entries.active_condition: Inactive when stebbs.enabled=False.
entries.rationale: 144-step STEBBS profile slots are unused when STEBBS is disabled.

entries.active_condition: Output group list is a user-selectable subset of diagnostic groups; removing an element omits that group from output.
entries.rationale: Deleting an element from model.control.output.groups shortens the list as intended for optional output group selection; explicit null elements are already rejected.

entries.active_condition: Active when storage_heat = 5 (EHC) on spartacus_ehc_stebbs.
entries.rationale: Even with EHC active, deleting an element silently truncates the 5-layer thermal array to 4 elements and bare null leaks into engine YAML across land_cover and vertical_layers roofs/walls.

entries.active_condition: Active when storage_heat = 6 (DyOHM) on observed_and_dyohm; bare_null is already rejected for bldgs thermal layers.
entries.rationale: DyOHM validates finite numeric elements on bldgs thermal_layers (rejecting bare_null) but does not enforce the 5-layer array length when an element is omitted.

entries.active_condition: Inactive when storage_heat = 1 (OHM); active EHC coverage is tracked on spartacus_ehc_stebbs.
entries.rationale: Thermal-layer arrays are unused under OHM; active EHC behaviour is tracked separately under thermal-layers-array-elements-ehc-active.

entries.active_condition: Inactive under storage_heat = 6 (DyOHM) outside bldgs; active EHC coverage is tracked on spartacus_ehc_stebbs.
entries.rationale: Under DyOHM only bldgs thermal_layers are validated for finite numeric elements; other surfaces and vertical layers remain optional.

entries.active_condition: Active when net_radiation = 1003 (SPARTACUS) on spartacus_ehc_stebbs.
entries.rationale: Unlike building_frac, building_scale, and height (which reject length != nlayer), omitting an element from veg_frac, veg_scale, or veg_ext silently truncates the 3-layer SPARTACUS array to 2 elements.

entries.active_condition: Inactive when SPARTACUS is disabled; active coverage is tracked on spartacus_ehc_stebbs.
entries.rationale: SPARTACUS vertical vegetation arrays are inactive on non-SPARTACUS anchors.

entries.active_condition: Always active for every site; hdd_id is a fixed 12-slot heating/cooling degree-day state vector.
entries.rationale: Explicit null elements in hdd_id are rejected, but deleting an element silently truncates the 12-element array to 11 elements.

entries.active_condition: Always triggered when {value: null} is supplied on vegetated LAI parameters.
entries.rationale: Passing {value: null} to lai.{base_temperature, gdd_full, lai_max} raises an uncaught TypeError comparing float and NoneType wrapped as 'suspected schema drift' with no field path attribution.

entries.active_condition: Always triggered when {value: null} is supplied on a 24-hour or 144-step profile slot.
entries.rationale: Passing {value: null} to a profile slot raises an uncaught TypeError in float() wrapped as 'suspected schema drift' without identifying the offending profile or slot.
